name: Citadines Connect Cecil Georgetown Penang
detail: A great little hotel with a strategic location, although it’s slightly on the outskirts of Georgetown. The rooms and overall space are compact, but everything is thoughtfully designed, modern, and well-equipped with complete facilities. Perfect for travelers who appreciate comfort, convenience, and modern amenities without needing a huge hotel room. Definitely a great stay in Penang!

name: Jazz Hotel Penang
detail: This was my first time booking at this hotel and my experience was very satisfying. The hotel staff were very friendly and provided excellent service to all guests, even those who were not VIPs. The room was comfortable, clean, and spacious. Although my room did not have an iron, I just had to call the hotel number to request one, and they sent an iron to my room right away. It was very convenient. For Muslim guests, there is a suitable space for prayers and a qibla direction marker on the ceiling. Parking inside the building is also easy and very convenient. The only slight improvement that could be made is regarding the Wi-Fi. Perhaps due to many guests using the Wi-Fi at the same time, the speed was somewhat slow. I hope the hotel can further enhance the quality and speed of the Wi-Fi in the future. I hope the hotel can continue to maintain the cleanliness of the rooms and the quality of service as it is now. Highly recommended and I will definitely come again!

name: Collection O Batu Ferringhi Beach formerly ESQ Ferringhi
detail: Cozy beds, spacious room, and awesome staff. We laughed through every photo attempt!

name: lyf Georgetown Penang
detail: It is conveniently located for both dining and sightseeing, and the hotel is clean and quiet. The staff is friendly. There is a 24-hour nasi kandar within walking distance, and you can get there almost without getting wet even if it rains. The bakery at the back also has a nice atmosphere. The traffic on the roads around the hotel is heavy, so be cautious if you have small children. Overall, I will definitely return.

name: Cititel Hotel Penang
detail: The hotel's biggest advantage is its outstanding location in the heart of George Town's historic district. Street art attractions, Clan Jetties, and many popular local food spots are all within walking distance, making it extremely convenient to explore the old town without constantly relying on taxis. The property is an older, traditional-style hotel. I booked a twin room, and the room offered a direct sea view, which exceeded my expectations. The room itself was relatively small, but considering the price, the value for money was reasonable. The facilities are somewhat dated, and during my stay I encountered minor issues such as a clogged sink and a toilet with weak flushing. These are fairly common problems in older hotels, and maintenance staff were able to resolve them after they were reported. Overall, the hotel adequately met my basic accommodation needs. The front desk has Mandarin-speaking staff, making communication easy and hassle-free. The service was friendly and attentive throughout my stay. I was also fortunate to try the hotel's newly installed self-service washer-dryer machine free of charge, which was especially useful for long-term travelers who need to do laundry. According to the staff, this service will become chargeable in the future. In addition, the hotel features a small swimming pool and a basic fitness room, providing practical options for relaxation and light exercise. Overall, this hotel is highly suitable for travelers seeking an affordable base to explore George Town's historic center. As long as you can accept the smaller room size and aging bathroom facilities, it offers excellent value thanks to its prime location, Mandarin-speaking staff, and convenient laundry facilities.

name: St. Giles Wembley Penang
detail: I arrived early and intended to wait until check-in time to handle my luggage, but they checked me in early. (The staff was very friendly) The hotel seems to be older, but the room, bathroom, and towels are all clean, and the entire hotel feels well-maintained. The hotel I stayed at in Kuala Lumpur was very disappointing in terms of cleanliness, towels, and breakfast, but this place is really satisfying for the price. There is a good variety for breakfast as well. I experienced constipation during my trip, but I appreciated having greens available. The location is also close to the mural street, which is great. This is my third accommodation in Malaysia during my ten-day stay, and this place is my favorite. The only downside is that there's a forced alarm from a nearby mosque in the early morning.

name: Cititel Express Penang Hotel
detail: The experience of this stay was very satisfying. The hotel is in a great location, with restaurants, convenience stores, and transportation stations nearby, making travel convenient. The room was very clean, with fresh air, a soft and comfortable bed, and the pillow height was just right; I slept very soundly. The staff were very friendly, whether at the front desk during check-in or providing local information, they were patient and thorough, making one feel very cared for. The hotel facilities were also very complete, with plenty of hot water, quiet air conditioning, and fast internet speed. The overall atmosphere was very quiet, allowing for true relaxation and rest. When leaving, I even felt a bit reluctant to go; I will choose this place again next time and will also recommend it to friends.

name: G Hotel Gurney
detail: After comparing various options for accommodation, I decided on this one because it seemed cost-effective and, more importantly, the gym appeared to be well-equipped. It turned out to be the right choice. Although I arrived quite a bit earlier than the check-in time, I was able to check in a little early since a room happened to be available. Thanks to that, I was able to enjoy my first day of sightseeing without wasting any time. First of all, I was amazed at how beautiful the building and the interior of the hall were, and I was impressed by the staff's attentiveness. The gym was even better than I expected and was extremely helpful. I think it might be a bit outside the city center, but since Grab rides are inexpensive, it really wasn't an issue at all. I believe I will definitely return to this place, and honestly, I'm even considering staying here again next time.

name: Hotel Penaga
detail: Penang self-service hotel 🏨 share [smirk R] A friend recommended it to me 😄 it's really great The reception and staff are quite nice [laugh out loud R] No deposit required, breakfast included, there’s a drinking water dispenser As a water buffalo 🐃 this is very important The room is super spacious, has a bathtub and is very clean The key point is that it has a strong Nanyang style, the decor is exquisite You can even take direct photos [smirk R] Very exquisite, also has a bathtub 🛀 There’s a sofa 🛋️ so the child can sleep separately without disturbance Great geographical location, just a short walk to the pedestrian street But it’s also very quiet at night 🤫 The air conditioning is powerful! There’s also a ceiling fan There’s a small fridge, it's a bit old but when it starts it sounds like a bomber plane [smirk R] It’s fine for storing some unfinished sweet soup Only a five to ten minute walk to mural street, Peranakan Museum, and Shantou Street night market Markets, police station, haha Wanxiang pastry shop and Beryl’s chocolate are also nearby! In summary, it’s really nice.

name: The Pink Boutique
detail: The pink hotel is really beautiful, and the environment inside is very comfortable, with an elevator that makes moving around very convenient. This time, we booked a relatively large room with a bathtub. The room is very clean, and overall, it is quite comfortable to stay in. There is also a small pool at the back of the hotel, and the nearby area is convenient, with tea restaurants and shopping malls within walking distance, making it easy to eat and shop. The only downside is that the private parking lot at the back of the hotel charges a bit much. Additionally, the hotel does not provide drinking water machines, so you need to prepare your own drinking water. Another point is that the soundproofing is rather average; at night, the noise from passing vehicles on the road can be quite noticeable, which may affect lighter sleepers. Overall, the hotel environment is beautiful, the rooms are clean, and the location is very convenient. The accommodation experience is quite good.
